payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the dataset used for the experiments, including the number of conversations and intents involved.

claims.text: The dataset consists of more than 70,000 US English phone conversations, each with an average duration of 11 minutes.
The dataset includes an intent library with 313 intents, each expressed using an average of 169 examples.
A sampled dataset of 500 rescored intent annotations was used for evaluation, focusing on cancellations and refunds.
